question: In Asia Cup 2022, against which of the following countries Virat Kohli scored an unbeaten 122 off 61 balls?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Afghanistan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Virat Kohli scored an unbeaten 122 runs off 61 balls against **Afghanistan** in the **Asia Cup 2022**.
 
• This innings marked **Virat Kohli’s first T20I century**, ending a 1020-day drought for an international century.
 
• The match was played on **8th September 2022** in Dubai.
 
• Kohli’s 122* is the **highest individual score by an Indian in T20Is**, surpassing Rohit Sharma’s 118.
 
• India posted a massive total of **212/2** and defeated Afghanistan by **101 runs**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asia Cup 2022**:

 
 
• The tournament was held in the **United Arab Emirates** from 27th August to 11th September 2022.
 
• It featured six teams: India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Afghanistan, Bangladesh, and Hong Kong.
 
• Sri Lanka won the Asia Cup 2022 by defeating Pakistan in the final.
 
 
 
• **Virat Kohli’s Career Milestones**:
 
 
• As of 2022, Kohli has scored **centuries in all three formats of international cricket**.
 
• He is one of the fastest players to reach **70 international centuries**.
 
 
 
• **T20I Cricket Records**:
 
 
• Chris Gayle holds the record for the **highest individual T20 score** of 175* in IPL 2013.
 
• Rohit Sharma has the most T20I centuries (4) as of 2022.
 
 
 
• **Dubai International Stadium**:
 
 
• Known for hosting international matches, the stadium is located in Dubai Sports City, UAE.
 
• It has a seating capacity of approximately **25,000** spectators.
